papers.title: Think-Capture: Active 3D Geometry Acquisition for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at 2D recognition but often fail to maintain consistent 3D relations across sparse viewpoints, leading to spatial hallucinations under occlusion and perspective changes. Existing methods commonly fuse all frames with dense geometry, incurring substantial computation and context overhead while encouraging blind reliance on imperfect estimators. We present Think-Capture, a query-conditioned framework that first identifies task-critical objects and then acquires their geometry on demand. A 3D toolkit lifts zero-shot masks into a common coordinate frame, and a Symbolic 3D State Abstraction compresses object and camera states into structured text. Hierarchical Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) trains the VLM on cases in which geometry either helps or misleads, teaching it when to use tool evidence and when to fall back on visual cues. Think-Capture-4B reaches 54.4% on MindCube-Tiny (+21.5 points over its backbone), 39.1% on the MMSI-Bench positional subset (+7.9), and 42.8% on ViewSpatial (+5.2). It also remains robust under coordinate and mask perturbations. The full stack fits one 24 GB GPU and serves as an asynchronous high-level reasoner on an Agibot G1. Our code is available at https://github.com/819346675/Think-Capture.

summary.takeaway: 提出 Think-Capture，一个查询条件化的框架，先识别任务关键物体，再按需获取几何信息，以缓解 VLM 在稀疏视角下的 3D 空间幻觉。
summary.methods: 用 3D 工具将零样本掩码提升到统一坐标系，以符号 3D 状态抽象把物体和相机状态压缩为结构化文本，并用分层 GRPO 训练 VLM 判断何时使用工具证据、何时回退到视觉线索。
summary.relevance: 与多模态学习、跨模态理解和强化学习主题相关，展示如何用 RL 训练 VLM 的主动几何获取与空间推理。
summary.caveat: 摘要只报告了基准分数和设备部署情况，未说明与密集几何融合基线的算力对比细节，也未给出消融各组件贡献的完整分析。

papers.title: SLoSa: Small, Low-Power, and Safe Foundation Models for Robotic Task Planning
papers.abstract: Safe robotic task planning requires planners that can reliably achieve task goals while satisfying safety constraints. Classical planners search over explicit symbolic task representations and can provide formal guarantees with respect to encoded safety constraints, but require rigid input formats. Their computational cost also increases rapidly with the search space. In contrast, large language models (LLMs) offer flexible task interfaces and strong generalization capabilities, but they are large, power-hungry, and pre-trained with little robot-specific safety data and knowledge. Thus, they can be difficult to deploy locally on robotic systems with limited resources. To address these limitations, we present SLoSa, a neuro-symbolic compression and fine-tuning framework for training foundation-model-based robotic task planners with Small size, Low power demand, and Safety awareness. The framework first constructs a safety-aware dataset using classical planners, an advanced teacher LLM, and formal verifiers, followed by two training stages: supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning guided by a verification-based reward machine to enforce safety alignment. We evaluate SLoSa across four Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) domains, two household simulation environments, local edge platforms, and a desktop robotic arm. Across the PDDL tasks, verifier-guided post-training raises the success rate of compact 4B-14B planners to 70.5-76.0%, while INT4 deployment on a Jetson Orin requires 17.85-26.41 W of average power. Results in household simulators and on the physical robot further demonstrate the applicability of SLoSa across diverse robotic task settings.

summary.takeaway: 提出 SLoSa，一个神经符号压缩与微调框架，用于训练小体积、低功耗且具备安全意识的机器人任务规划基础模型。
summary.methods: 先用经典规划器、教师 LLM 和形式验证器构建安全感知数据集，再经监督微调和以验证奖励机引导的 RL 微调；在四个 PDDL 域、两个家庭仿真环境、边缘平台和桌面机械臂上评估。
summary.relevance: 与 LLM、强化学习和预训练主题相关，探讨用验证器引导的后训练把安全约束注入紧凑规划模型。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明安全约束的形式化覆盖范围，也未给出与经典规划器在完备性或可保证性上的对比；物理机器人实验细节有限。

papers.title: YingLan: A Multimodal Ocean Foundation Model for Unified Representation Learning from Heterogeneous Observations
papers.abstract: Multimodal ocean modeling remains challenging due to substantial heterogeneity in data structures, physical semantics, and spatiotemporal characteristics across satellite imagery, gridded oceanographic fields, and buoy observations. Existing approaches largely focus on task-specific ocean modeling, while learning transferable representations from heterogeneous observations remains an open problem. To address this challenge, we propose YingLan, a multimodal ocean foundation model that integrates physics-attribute-conditioned dynamic encoding, Spatiotemporal Increment Coupling (STIC), and ocean-state evolution-aware pretraining. Specifically, the dynamic encoding mechanism generates adaptive input projections conditioned on physical semantics and observation characteristics, enabling flexible representation of heterogeneous ocean variables. STIC models multiscale spatiotemporal dependencies through cross-scale interactions of latent temporal increments. The pretraining strategy further combines masked observation reconstruction with temporal evolution objectives to facilitate the learning of coherent ocean-state representations across different prediction horizons. YingLan is implemented using MindSpore and trained on Huawei Ascend 910B NPUs, demonstrating its compatibility with domestic AI computing infrastructure. In a seven-day sea surface salinity (SSS) forecasting task conducted in the Shenzhen coastal waters, YingLan achieves an average RMSE of 0.687508 PSU, corresponding to relative error reductions of 0.58%, 5.31%, and 12.42% compared with LangYa, XiHe, and GloNet2, respectively. These results provide initial evidence of the model's effectiveness in regional ocean forecasting, while broader cross-task and cross-regional evaluations remain necessary to assess its generalization capabilities.

summary.takeaway: 提出 YingLan，一个多模态海洋基础模型，从卫星影像、网格化海洋场和浮标观测等异质数据中学习统一表示。
summary.methods: 结合物理属性条件化动态编码、跨尺度潜在时间增量的时空增量耦合（STIC），以及掩码观测重建加时间演化目标的预训练；用 MindSpore 在昇腾 910B 上训练。
summary.relevance: 与预训练和自监督表示学习主题相关，面向异质观测的统一表示学习。
summary.caveat: 摘要明确指出仅在深圳近海一周表层盐度预测上验证，跨任务、跨区域泛化仍待评估，结论只是初步证据。

papers.title: SCODEL: Shared Canonical Ontology Definitions for Food Entity Linking and Ontology-Grounded Recipe Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract: Identifying recipe entities and linking them to ontology concepts is fundamental for semantic recipe understanding. However, food mentions in recipes are often ambiguous, context-dependent, and lexically diverse, making ontology entity linking (EL) challenging. We propose SCODEL, a streamlined, model-agnostic approach based on a central idea: contextual food mentions and ontology concepts that refer to the same entity should learn the same canonical ontology-oriented definition. SCODEL uses these shared definitions as a semantic normalisation layer, providing complementary semantic information to existing EL models without requiring a new linking architecture. We further introduce ReciLinkD, the first benchmark for contextual food ontology entity linking in recipes. Experiments show that SCODEL consistently improves three modular EL models (ReFinED, GSM-EL, and BLINK): SCODEL x BLINK achieves the highest Hit@1 on seen concepts (88.33%), while SCODEL x GSM-EL achieves the highest Hit@1 on unseen concepts (83.15%), outperforming the strongest large language model (LLM) based EL baseline in each setting. Experiments on a biomedical ontology benchmark further demonstrate that SCODEL generalises beyond the food domain. Finally, we use SCODEL to ground food mentions at scale and construct an ontology-grounded recipe knowledge graph, demonstrating its utility for ontology-aware recipe retrieval and corpus-level food analysis.

summary.takeaway: 提出 SCODEL，让上下文中的食物提及与本体概念学习同一套规范本体定义作为语义归一化层，并发布首个食谱上下文食物本体实体链接基准 ReciLinkD。
summary.methods: 模型无关地增强现有实体链接模型（ReFinED、GSM-EL、BLINK），在食谱基准和生物医学本体基准上做实验，并用于大规模构建本体接地食谱知识图谱。
summary.relevance: 与知识图谱、图谱构建和大语言模型主题相关，涉及本体实体链接与知识图谱接地。
summary.caveat: 摘要只给出 Hit@1 指标，未说明端到端知识图谱构建的规模与质量评估细节；对未见概念的提升依赖具体搭配模型。

papers.title: APRIL: Ambiguity-Aware Expert Routing for Respiratory Sound Domain-Incremental Learning
papers.abstract: Automated respiratory sound classification enables continuous, non-invasive respiratory assessment, yet long-term deployment remains challenging due to domain shifts from evolving recording devices and acquisition periods. When privacy and governance regulations prohibit replaying historical data, sequential learning easily overwrites previously acquired knowledge. Preserving dedicated domain experts prevents parameter interference, but selecting the correct expert at inference is difficult under overlapping acoustic distributions and absent domain labels. To resolve this dilemma, we propose APRIL, an exemplar-free domain-incremental framework for RSC. Built on a shared frozen BEATs backbone, APRIL sequentially inherits and isolates low-rank experts to enable new-domain adaptation without altering earlier models. A multi-level prototype router retrieves the top-two candidate experts and dynamically selects the final model by integrating domain-routing posteriors with classification confidence, adaptively weighted by matching ambiguity. We establish standardized device- and temporal-incremental benchmarks on the ICBHI and SPRSound datasets across forward and reversed domain orders. Evaluated over five random seeds, APRIL consistently achieves the highest final-session average Score among compared continual learning approaches, reaching 64.4% and 65.4% on ICBHI, and 83.1% and 82.2% on SPRSound under forward and reversed sequences, respectively. Crucially, average forgetting remains under 1.0% across all protocols, demonstrating robust domain adaptation and long-term knowledge retention without data replay. Overall, APRIL offers a reliable and privacy-preserving paradigm for deploying continuous respiratory sound classification across real-world healthcare settings.

summary.takeaway: 提出 APRIL，一个无样本回放的域增量呼吸音分类框架，通过歧义感知的专家路由在无域标签下选择合适专家。
summary.methods: 基于冻结的 BEATs 主干，顺序继承并隔离低秩专家；多级原型路由器检索前二候选专家，并按匹配歧义加权融合域路由后验与分类置信度；在 ICBHI 和 SPRSound 上构建设备与时间增量基准。
summary.relevance: 与持续学习和持续适应主题相关，针对隐私约束下不可回放历史数据的域增量学习。
summary.caveat: 摘要中的评估限于两个呼吸音数据集和五随机种子，未说明跨更多设备类型或真实临床部署的泛化表现。

papers.title: Agentic Ensemble with Vision-Language Models for Visual Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract: Visual anomaly detection aims to detect abnormal objects, while anomaly samples are often scarce during model training. Assembling multiple pretrained detectors can help by leveraging their transferable image scores and anomaly maps. However, most existing ensemble methods apply fixed fusion rules over saved predictions which struggle when pretrained detectors clearly disagree due to different training objectives, priors, and visual representations. To this end, we design AnomalyAgent, a post-training fusion framework for accurate visual anomaly detection. AnomalyAgent aligns heterogeneous scores and maps, summarizes score- and region-level disagreement, and treats fusion as a finite action-selection problem. It implements two types of actions: 1) score actions that determine how to fuse image-level detector confidence via consensus, robust aggregation, detector weighting, or score-map consistency; 2) map actions that fuse dense anomaly responses via consensus, detector weighting, geometric aggregation, or disagreement correction. A constrained vision-language model (VLM) is introduced to inspect high-conflict samples and select valid score action and map action to produce the final prediction. We evaluate AnomalyAgent on MVTec AD and VisA as primary benchmarks, together with seven additional public anomaly benchmarks and Real-IAD for large-scale score-level evaluation. Across these benchmarks, AnomalyAgent consistently improves over equal-weight fusion and achieves the best mean image AUROC and pixel AP among the compared fusion methods on MVTec AD and VisA, while demonstrating robust transfer across additional anomaly domains.

summary.takeaway: 提出 AnomalyAgent，一个训练后融合框架，把多预训练检测器的分数与异常图融合建模为有限动作选择问题，并用受限 VLM 处理高冲突样本。
summary.methods: 对齐异质分数和图，汇总分数级与区域级分歧，定义分数动作与图动作两类；由受限 VLM 检查高冲突样本并选择有效动作组合；在 MVTec AD、VisA 及另外七个异常基准和 Real-IAD 上评估。
summary.relevance: 与多模态学习和跨模态理解主题相关，体现 VLM 作为推理器参与集成决策。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明 VLM 调用带来的推理开销与延迟，也未给出各动作类型对最终增益的消融结果。

papers.title: CheckDistill: Adaptive Checklist Distillation for Efficient Distributional Reward Modeling in Image Editing
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning for instruction-guided image editing requires reward models that provide reliable, accurate, and efficient feedback. Direct scalar prediction compresses multidimensional editing preferences, whereas generative evaluators can expose their judgment through explicit reasoning. However, broad scoring criteria do not specify all instance-dependent editing and preservation constraints, and generating long reasoning trajectories is costly for online optimization. We introduce CheckDistill, a pointwise reward modeling framework that internalizes instruction-adaptive checklists. We decompose each editing condition into atomic, independently verifiable requirements and construct four-dimensional scoring labels together with structured verification evidence. After supervised score initialization, a privileged teacher conditions on checklists, item-level judgments, and dimension-level rationales to supervise the student's own scoring trajectories. A reliability-weighted on-policy self-distillation objective adjusts supervision at score tokens according to agreement between the teacher's expected scores and reference labels, while retaining candidate probability weights in a truncated token support. The deployed student directly predicts four score distributions without checklist inputs or explicit reasoning and aggregates their expectations into a scalar reward. CheckDistill achieves aggregate accuracies of 72.30%, 56.67% and 82.90% on MMRB2, MER-Bench and EditReward-Bench, respectively, exceeding the compared open-source baselines on all three metrics.

summary.takeaway: 提出 CheckDistill，一个逐点奖励建模框架，把指令自适应检查单内化到学生模型中，实现高效分布化奖励预测。
summary.methods: 将编辑条件分解为原子可验证要求，构建四维评分标签与结构化验证证据；经监督分数初始化后，由带检查单与理由的特权教师做可靠性加权的在线自蒸馏；部署学生直接预测四个分数分布并聚合为标量奖励。
summary.relevance: 与强化学习和多智能体奖励学习主题相关，为图像编辑的 RL 提供高效奖励模型。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告三个基准上的聚合准确率，未说明奖励模型与下游编辑策略联合优化时的实际训练收益与开销。

papers.title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Market Making on Prediction-Market Order Books
papers.abstract: A market maker provides liquidity by quoting prices to buy and sell an asset, earning the spread while managing inventory risk. We study market makers trained with multi-agent reinforcement learning on prediction markets, specifically Polymarket, whose thin order books pose distinct challenges. Three challenges underpin this research: adverse selection may cause a policy trained on real data to stop quoting; the consequences of a quote can arrive many steps after the action; and prediction-market L2 data does not identify individual orders needed for simulation. We address these challenges by reconstructing order-level LOBSTER-format data from Polymarket and training agents in JaxMARL-HFT on 417 real markets. We enrich the baseline market maker's observation space with the book and recent flow, redesign its actions and inventory controls, and propose a cooperative multi-agent decomposition into a quoter and a risk manager trained using recurrent Independent Proximal Policy Optimisation (IPPO) with RNN policies. We investigate reward shaping, particularly reward blending and post-fill markout, to mitigate credit-assignment difficulties between the agents. Our redesigned single-agent market maker quotes more frequently and incurs smaller held-out losses than the retrained JaxMARL-HFT baseline, although the contributions of jointly changed observations, actions and risk constraints are not separately identified. Decomposition alone performs poorly; careful reward design substantially improves the desk relative to the unshaped split and yields our best result. Models are evaluated on realised end-of-episode portfolio value on held-out markets. None establishes positive average portfolio value in periodic held-out evaluation, and each configuration was trained with one seed. The environment, data and protocol lay a foundation for makers that quote many linked markets at once.

summary.takeaway: 在 Polymarket 预测市场订单簿上研究合作式多智能体 RL 做市，将做市分解为报价者与风险管理器，并用奖励设计缓解信用分配问题。
summary.methods: 从 Polymarket 重建 LOBSTER 格式订单级数据，在 JaxMARL-HFT 上对 417 个真实市场训练；增强观测空间、重设计动作与库存控制，用带 RNN 策略的循环 IPPO 训练报价者与风险管理器，并研究奖励混合与成交后 markout。
summary.relevance: 与强化学习和多智能体与奖励学习主题相关，是 MARL 在金融做市场景的应用研究。
summary.caveat: 作者自述没有任何配置在周期性留出评估中取得正的平均组合价值，且每种配置仅用单一随机种子训练，联合改动的各因素贡献未被单独识别。

papers.title: Genetic Perturbation Prediction Models Fail Out-of-Distribution: A Rigorous Benchmark and Systematic Evaluation
papers.abstract: Perturbation prediction models - which forecast transcriptional responses to gene inactivation - are increasingly proposed as in silico surrogates for genome-scale drug discovery screens. Yet, rigorous evaluation of whether these models genuinely generalize beyond their training distribution has been lacking. Existing benchmarks rely predominantly on random train-test splits, obscuring systematic failure modes that only emerge under realistic out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions. Here we introduce EL-PERTURB (Extrapolative Learning for PERTURBation Prediction), a benchmarking framework that stress-tests 20 perturbation prediction models spanning six architecture classes on both essential gene and genome-wide Perturb-seq screens, using a novel stratified OOD splitting strategy that partitions train and test sets into functionally distinct regions of transcriptional space. We find that model performance degrades substantially under OOD conditions, and that architectural complexity - including single-cell foundation model embeddings - confers no reliable advantage over well-tuned simpler baselines. EL-PERTURB establishes a rigorous benchmark for perturbation effect prediction across a gradient of generalization difficulty, providing a guide for building models that can genuinely serve as surrogates for wet-lab screening.

summary.takeaway: 提出 EL-PERTURB 基准，发现20个扰动预测模型在分布外条件下性能显著下降，且架构复杂度（包括单细胞基础模型嵌入）并不比调优良好的简单基线可靠。
summary.methods: 构建 EL-PERTURB 基准框架，采用分层 OOD 划分策略把训练集和测试集分到转录空间功能不同区域，在必需基因和全基因组 Perturb-seq 筛选上测试六类架构的20个模型。
summary.relevance: 直接关联单细胞扰动预测、Cell Foundation Model 与预训练评估，质疑以基础模型嵌入提升泛化的假设。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体性能数值、模型清单或统计细节；结论限于所测数据集与 OOD 划分设定。

papers.title: BrainCodes: A Lightweight EEG Foundation Model over Discrete Neural Codes
papers.abstract: Recent electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models increasingly emphasize model scale, potentially limiting their deployment on resource-constrained devices and in everyday environments. We argue that transferable EEG features can instead be learned with a compact architecture and introduce BrainCodes, a lightweight foundation model pretrained through self-supervised learning on more than 800 hours of recordings from over 1,000 participants. Our architecture combines a quantization-based neural tokenizer with a spatiotemporal encoder that supports arbitrary electrode configurations. The pretraining objective explicitly encourages representations that capture spatial connectivity through channel positional encoding, and sensitivity to narrowband neural oscillations through an auxiliary training objective. Our model matches or surpasses the state of the art across diverse neurophysiological monitoring tasks, including sleep staging, attention assessment, and cognitive load estimation. BrainCodes transfers effectively to low-resource wearable devices while using up to 97% fewer trainable parameters than comparable architectures. Beyond predictive accuracy, our evaluation framework characterizes the geometry and invariances of learned EEG representations across measurable spatial, temporal, and spectral signal properties.

summary.takeaway: 提出轻量 EEG 基础模型 BrainCodes，用离散神经码和自监督预训练在多项神经生理任务上匹配或超过现有方法，并使用最多少97%的可训练参数。
summary.methods: 在超过1000名受试者、逾800小时 EEG 记录上自监督预训练；结合量化神经 tokenizer 与支持任意电极配置的时空编码器，通过通道位置编码和辅助目标强调空间连通性与窄带振荡敏感性。
summary.relevance: 涉及预训练、自监督表示学习及 EEG 基础模型的轻量化部署。
summary.caveat: 效率增益和性能比较的具体细节需查原文；摘要未说明低资源可穿戴场景的实际验证规模。

papers.title: JaxMARL-BC: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Macroeconomic Modelling, in Seconds
papers.abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) offers a principled way of populating simulated economies with many heterogeneous decision makers. Its adoption, pioneered in finance, has nonetheless been slow in macroeconomics because of two main limitations: the lack of a shared frame of reference connecting MARL systems to dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) models the profession already trusts, and the very long training times. The first limitation was recently addressed by the Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Business Cycle (MARL-BC), which places deep RL households in a real business cycle economy and reduces to classic DSGE models in specific limits. Here we address the second limitation. We present JaxMARL-BC, a JAX-accelerated simulator that trains MARL-BC economies in seconds (between 75x and 724x faster than the reference implementation), and scales to 200,000 independent learning households. We verify its correctness against the known DSGE limits, characterise its scaling through a simple cost law, and demonstrate its value by a proof-of-concept calibration of an extended model with heterogeneous returns on capital, in a two-hour experiment that would previously have taken over a month. We release JaxMARL-BC as open source.

summary.takeaway: 发布 JAX 加速的 JaxMARL-BC 模拟器，将 MARL-BC 宏观经济模型训练提速75至724倍，并可扩展至20万个独立学习家庭。
summary.methods: 用 JAX 重写 MARL-BC 模拟器，对照已知 DSGE 极限验证正确性，刻画扩展成本规律，并做异质资本回报扩展模型的验证性校准实验。
summary.relevance: 属于多智能体强化学习与奖励学习方向，关注 MARL 在宏观经济模拟中的可扩展训练。
summary.caveat: 提速倍数为相对参考实现的基准结果；校准为概念验证，尚未证明对真实宏观数据的预测价值。

papers.title: Compositionality with Primitives: A Unified View from Euclidean to Hyperbolic Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Compositional zero-shot learning (CZSL) aims to recognize novel combinations of previously observed objects and attributes. Prior work showed that large-scale vision-language models encode decomposable semantic structures that can be recomposed to enable generalization. The Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE) framework formalizes this by identifying directions in the tangent space at the Frechet mean of the embedding distribution, which encode primitive visual concepts. Unseen attribute-object compositions can be synthesized through vector addition of these primitives. We revisit the assumption that compositional generalization requires explicit attribute-object pair re-composition. By means of new compositional scoring functions and extensive evaluations, we show that directly using the decomposed primitives suffices for recognizing unseen compositions. In that, we gain insights on how the geometry of the embedding manifold (Euclidean, spherical, or hyperbolic) and dataset structure affect compositional reasoning. Across models (CLIP, DINOv2, MERU, HyCoCLIP), we show that compositional structure consistently emerges as primitive representations, enabling inference on CZSL benchmarks (MIT-States, VAW-CZSL, UT-Zappos50K, Clothing16K) and group robustness on Waterbirds and CelebA. Code: https://github.com/nis-research/Compositionality-with-Primitives.

summary.takeaway: 重新审视 GDE 框架，表明直接使用分解出的原始概念表示即可识别未见属性-对象组合，并分析嵌入流形几何与数据集结构对组合推理的影响。
summary.methods: 提出新的组合评分函数，在 CLIP、DINOv2、MERU、HyCoCLIP 上评估，覆盖 MIT-States、VAW-CZSL、UT-Zappos50K、Clothing16K 及 Waterbirds、CelebA 的组鲁棒性。
summary.relevance: 关联多模态学习与跨模态理解中的组合泛化，涉及欧氏、球面与双曲视觉-语言模型。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体精度提升幅度；结论依赖所选集基准和模型族。

papers.title: Asking What a Director Sees Can Change What Vision-Language Models Choose
papers.abstract: Vision-language models are now routinely tested on theory of mind: whether they can work out what another person sees, knows, and means. A common design asks the model to report that perspective and then to act for the person, and reads a correct report beside a wrong action as a failure to use the perspective. That reading rests on a quiet assumption: that asking for the report leaves the action unchanged. We show that it does not. In a rendered Director Task, a partition hides the largest block from a director who asks for "the largest block". Asking first which blocks the director can see raises the share of replies that choose this hidden block by 12 to 88 percentage points on six GPT models and by 17 on Qwen3.8-27B, even though the models mostly report correctly which blocks the director sees. Reasoning traces and prompt rewordings suggest why: the question shifts how the request is read, from the director's view toward the model's own. When the prompt states what the director knows and refers to, fewer than 1% of replies pair a correct report with a hidden-block choice. Any evaluation that elicits a perspective report before the action it scores needs a baseline without the question, and we deliver one: paired prompts that differ only in that question, a design any perspective-taking benchmark can adopt.

summary.takeaway: 在渲染版 Director Task 中发现，先询问模型导演能看到哪些积木会显著改变其后续选择，即使模型多数能正确报告视角，说明视角报告与行动并非独立。
summary.methods: 用成对提示（仅差是否先询问视角）测试六个 GPT 模型和 Qwen3.8-27B，并结合推理轨迹与提示改写分析原因。
summary.relevance: 涉及多模态学习与跨模态理解中的视角采择评估方法。
summary.caveat: 结果基于特定渲染 Director Task 与所列模型；数字为摘要报告的选择变化百分点，需原文核实统计细节。

papers.title: Failure Modes of Vision-Language Models for Human Activity Understanding in Thermal HRI
papers.abstract: Thermal cameras enable robots to perceive human activities in darkness while revealing less personally identifiable appearance information and fewer details of the surrounding environment than RGB cameras. As vision-language models (VLMs), originally developed for RGB imagery, are increasingly integrated into embodied systems for scene understanding and high-level planning, thermal sensing offers a promising way to extend activity perception to low-light and privacy-sensitive settings. However, the failure modes of VLMs in thermal human activity understanding for human-robot interaction (HRI) remain underexplored. We fill this gap by evaluating seven locally deployable VLMs, including models developed for physical AI and robotics, on two person-centric thermal datasets. Our diagnostic tasks examine fine-grained action recognition, activity timeline reconstruction, and the ability to withhold unsupported answers. Paired RGB recordings serve as a performance reference, while controlled variations in frame sampling, thermal input presentation, and reasoning are used to assess whether the observed errors can be mitigated. Our results show that models can recognize broad activity categories but struggle with fine-grained actions such as coughing, sneezing, and yawning. They also produce inaccurate event timelines and hallucinate actions involving objects. Simple thermal input preprocessing and additional reasoning offer only limited, model-dependent gains. Abstention behavior also varies across models even under explicit instructions, limiting their reliability for practical robotic use.

summary.takeaway: 系统评估七个可本地部署 VLM 在热成像人体活动理解中的失败模式：能识别宽泛活动类别，但在细粒度动作、时间线重建和不支持答案抑制上表现不佳。
summary.methods: 在两个以人为中心的热成像数据集上做细粒度动作识别、活动时间线重建和拒答能力诊断，以配对 RGB 记录作参照，并控制帧采样、热输入呈现和推理方式。
summary.relevance: 属于多模态学习与跨模态理解，关注 VLM 在热成像人机交互中的可靠性。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体准确率或拒答率；简单预处理与额外推理的增益有限且依赖模型。

papers.title: Re-evaluating the benefit of pretraining scale in cell foundation models
papers.abstract: Single-cell foundation models are self-supervised neural networks pretrained on millions of cellular transcriptomes to learn representations that transfer across biological domains and downstream tasks. Recent benchmarks have questioned the training data scaling law for these models, showing early finetuning performance saturation on a fraction of available pretraining data. However, whether this trend holds for larger second-generation foundation models, and whether it reflects genuine saturation of foundation representations remains unclear. To resolve these aspects, we tested the performance of second- and first-generation cell foundation models across corpus sizes using the standard finetuning approach, and extended it with a comprehensive fully frozen evaluation. We revealed that the training-data scaling relationship becomes apparent under fully frozen finetuning, particularly for second-generation models. Zero-shot analyses similarly recovered dependence on pretraining scale. We conclude that finetuning performance saturation does not imply biological representations saturation, and that a shift in standards of cell foundation model evaluation is needed, complementing standard finetuning with fully frozen benchmarking to capture the quality of the foundation representations.

summary.takeaway: 发现标准微调下的性能饱和不等于生物表示饱和：在完全冻结评估下，第二代细胞基础模型的训练数据扩展规律重新显现，零样本分析也恢复对预训练规模的依赖。
summary.methods: 在不同语料规模上测试第一代和第二代细胞基础模型，比较标准微调与全面完全冻结微调评估，并做零样本分析。
summary.relevance: 直接关联 Cell Foundation Model 与预训练规模评估标准。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体性能数值或模型数量；结论基于所测模型与语料规模。

papers.title: Leveraging Time-Series Foundation Models for Financial Crime Detection
papers.abstract: Financial crime detection requires identifying illicit activity within large transaction networks, where suspicious behaviour is rare and unfolds over time. Existing graph-based methods capture relationships among accounts but typically underuse the temporal behaviour encoded in account transaction histories. We introduce Temporal-Context Edge Enrichment (TCEE), a framework that addresses this gap by summarising each account's transaction history with a frozen time-series foundation model (TSFM), and enriching each transaction's representation with the relevant temporal context from these summaries. These enriched representations can be scored directly for edge classification, or fed into a graph neural network (GNN) as edge features to capture broader structural information. Across six AMLWorld datasets, TCEE improves PR-AUC over the strongest evaluated baseline on five by a relative 10.8% on average, while training 6.0x faster end-to-end. Feeding TCEE's representations into a GNN raises PR-AUC a further 4.8% on the four smaller datasets. On an Ethereum phishing dataset, we show that TSFM-generated account representations fed into a GNN are also effective for node classification, improving PR-AUC by 14.5% over the strongest baseline. As TSFMs continue to advance, our results suggest they can strengthen financial crime detection by capturing temporal signals that complement graph-based approaches.

summary.takeaway: 提出 TCEE 框架，用冻结的时间序列基础模型汇总账户交易历史并丰富交易表示，在多个反洗钱数据集上提升 PR-AUC，同时端到端训练更快。
summary.methods: 在六个 AMLWorld 数据集与一个以太坊钓鱼数据集上评估；TCEE 表示可直接用于边分类，或作为边特征输入 GNN，账户表示也可用于节点分类。
summary.relevance: 涉及预训练时间序列基础模型的迁移应用，并与图方法结合做金融犯罪检测。
summary.caveat: 提升幅度为相对最强基线的 PR-AUC 变化，摘要未报告绝对指标与数据集规模；结果依赖所测 TSFM。

papers.title: Can Quantum Layers offer Performance and Security Advantages in Vision-Language Models?
papers.abstract: As quantum computing moves from the noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) era toward early fault-tolerant quantum computing (EFTQC), quantum-enhanced AI is shifting from a conceptual idea to experimental research. Quantum components are expected to extend the capabilities of existing AI systems, yet it remains unclear how such components will help within large multimodal models. In this study, we try to answer that question for vision-language models (VLMs) using classically simulated quantum layers. With LLaVA-OneVision as the backbone, we evaluate 4- and 8-qubit basic-ring and strongly entangling circuits at four insertion and four replacement locations. Insertion adds quantum layers to the classical model, while replacement substitutes them for classical components. Using the same setup, we compare performance and computational cost between classical and quantum-classical hybrid models. On the Visual Spatial Reasoning dataset, inserting a quantum layer after the visual projector reaches 80.7% development accuracy, 2.28 percentage-points above classical full fine-tuning. Replacing the final decoder feed-forward sublayer retains 79.22% accuracy with 13.07 million fewer trainable parameters. Quantum insertion can thus improve accuracy, and selective replacement can reduce parameters. These benefits depend strongly on where the quantum layer is inserted or which classical component it replaces: earlier replacements lower accuracy, and fewer parameters do not reliably shorten training or reduce computation. To assess potential security benefits, we evaluated the robustness of quantum-classical hybrid models under six attack settings. Overall, our study maps where quantum layers help and hurt within VLMs, offering a starting point for hybrid VLM design; whether these gains generalize remains open. The code is available at https://github.com/TITANS-Lab-Artifacts/QuantumVLM.

summary.takeaway: 该研究在LLaVA-OneVision视觉语言模型上以经典模拟的量子层探索插入或替换量子层对性能与参数量的影响，并评估其在六种攻击设置下的鲁棒性。
summary.methods: 以4比特和8比特的基本环形与强纠缠量子电路，在四种插入位置和四种替换位置构造经典-量子混合模型，在Visual Spatial Reasoning数据集上比较性能与计算成本，并进行六种攻击设置下的鲁棒性测试。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于多模态学习与跨模态理解，讨论视觉语言模型结构改造对精度、参数效率和鲁棒性的影响，可为混合模型设计提供参考。
summary.caveat: 量子层由经典模拟实现，并非真实量子硬件；结论高度依赖插入或替换位置，且摘要指出这些收益能否泛化仍属开放问题，参数量减少也未可靠降低训练或计算开销。

papers.title: P$^3$-VLM: A Point-based Alternative for Grounded 3D Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Examining existing benchmarks for grounding in 3D VLMs reveals a pervasive "semantic leakage" in the evaluation and prompting protocols: a heavy reliance on bounding boxes as spatial prompts or representation primitives. Because bounding boxes are highly informative of object categories, they introduce a shortcut for the models to neglect visual information during 3D VLM training. We demonstrate this with a "blind" LLM that, prompted only with the box coordinates, can perform surprisingly well. To further analyze this shortcut, we propose point-based grounding prompting - querying models with a single 3D point instead of a box. Under this protocol, the accuracy of the blind LLM drops from 36.4% to 18.0% on ScanNet's Nr3D, and similarly degrades for 3D VLMs (e.g. LL3DA). Building on this insight, we introduce P$^3$-VLM, a novel tri-pathway 3D VLM that supports point-based prompts and achieves 52.1% state-of-the-art accuracy on location-grounded captioning under this setting. To achieve this, we redesign the architecture while keeping it detector-free, scene-centric, and suitable for 3D GS inputs. P$^3$-VLM utilizes three complementary pathways (location-, task-, and context-aware), enabling strong reasoning about scenes without any bounding box dependencies. The key benefit of point-based learning is a consistent improvement across settings: P$^3$-VLM achieves state-of-the-art performance under point-based grounding while also improving robustness, OOD generalization, and performance on ungrounded scene-centric 3D VQA benchmarks, reflecting its reduced reliance on bounding-box shortcuts and resulting stronger visual-spatial reasoning.

summary.takeaway: 论文指出3D视觉语言模型评测中包围盒提示造成“语义泄漏”捷径，并提出以单点提示替代包围盒的P^3-VLM三路径模型。
summary.methods: 先用仅接收包围盒坐标的"blind" LLM展示捷径效应，再改为点提示协议；提出包含位置、任务与上下文三条路径、无检测器、以场景为中心且支持3D GS输入的P^3-VLM，并在ScanNet Nr3D等基准上评测。
summary.relevance: 该工作面向多模态学习与跨模态理解，关注3D视觉语言定位中的提示设计与评测可靠性，与跨模态理解相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要主要报告定位式描述与相关基准结果，未详细说明训练数据规模、计算成本和三类路径的具体实现细节，跨数据集泛化程度仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Graph Topology Meets Energy-Driven Pathfinding: Preserving Contextual Consistency in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frequently integrates knowledge graphs (KGs) for complex multi-hop question answering. However, their performance is increasingly bottlenecked by the knowledge structuring and reasoning processes. (i) Severe semantic loss: Distilling continuous texts into discrete symbols strips away contextual nuances and narrative coherence. (ii) Pronounced modality mismatch: Fragmented graph structures clash with the continuous texts LLMs are pre-trained on, while rewriting them into natural language introduces generative noise and omits information. To address these limitations, we propose ThreadRAG, a semantic-topology-based RAG framework for context-preserving knowledge structuring and modality-native evidence reasoning. ThreadRAG introduces a Semantic Topology Mapper (STM), which organizes retrieved documents into context-intact Semantic Nodes and constructs a Semantic Topology Graph (STG) through narrative, semantic, and lexical edges. It further incorporates Energy-Driven Pathfinding (EDP), which identifies query-relevant subgraphs via energy diffusion and deterministically linearizes them into coherent textual evidence paths. Experiments on three multi-hop QA benchmarks demonstrate that ThreadRAG consistently outperforms strong baselines. Notably, it achieves a 14.4% EM improvement over text-centric methods on HotpotQA and surpasses the best baseline by 5.8% EM on 2WikiMultihop, while reducing token cost to 23.3% of the strongest baseline.

summary.takeaway: ThreadRAG提出基于语义拓扑的RAG框架，以保持上下文的语义节点和语义拓扑图组织文档，并用能量驱动路径寻找生成连贯文本证据。
summary.methods: 引入Semantic Topology Mapper将检索文档组织为语义节点并构建含叙事、语义与词汇边的语义拓扑图，再用Energy-Driven Pathfinding通过能量扩散识别查询相关子图并确定性线性化为文本证据路径，在三个多跳QA基准上评测。
summary.relevance: 该工作直接面向检索增强与对齐以及知识图谱，针对图结构RAG的语义损失与模态不匹配问题，属于检索增强与知识图谱交叉方向。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出在三个多跳QA基准上的改进，未说明所用LLM骨干、图构建成本与噪声敏感性；其确定性线性化对开放域或长文档场景的适用性尚不明确。

papers.title: Automated Materials Data and Knowledge Extraction using Machine Learning and Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Over the past decade, substantial efforts have been devoted to developing machine learning (ML) methods for extracting materials data and, where possible, materials knowledge directly from the scientific literature. This review traces the evolution of these methods from heuristic, rule-based pipelines through natural language processing (NLP) models and transformer-based encoders to, lastly, large language models (LLMs) and agentic systems capable of extracting materials information across multiple modalities, including text, tables, and figures. Beside construction of large, queryable materials databases and knowledge graphs that support downstream materials discovery, we discuss how these advances have enabled new capabilities, such as, generic question answering across materials science, AI co-scientists and chatbots for research assistance, and closed-loop optimization and discovery when integrated with autonomous laboratories. We critically assess the datasets generated using these approaches, their extraction accuracy and computational costs, and the respective strengths and limitations of different methodologies, and even provide practical guidelines for developing more reliable and scalable materials data extraction pipelines. Finally, we identify key open challenges, including the extraction of full materials structure-property-processing-performance tetrahedron at the sample level, the scarcity of reliable benchmark datasets for systematic evaluation, and the resolution of non-standard materials terminology across different document modalities.

summary.takeaway: 该综述梳理从规则管线、NLP与Transformer编码器到大语言模型和智能体系统的材料数据与知识抽取方法演进，并讨论数据库、知识图谱及AI辅助科研等应用。
summary.methods: 综述性工作，按方法代际组织文献，覆盖文本、表格和图像多模态抽取，并批判性评估生成数据集、抽取精度与计算成本，提出实用流程指南与开放挑战。
summary.relevance: 该文与大语言模型和知识图谱主题相关，讨论LLM在科学文献信息抽取、知识图谱构建和闭环发现中的作用。
summary.caveat: 作为综述，摘要未提供新的实验结果或统一基准；作者指出样本级全结构-性能-工艺-性能四面体抽取、可靠基准数据缺乏及术语不统一等挑战仍未解决。

papers.title: Parallel Thinking for Large Language Model with Path Diversity
papers.abstract: Parallel thinking has emerged as a promising paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) by exploring multiple reasoning paths simultaneously. However, we identify that parallel thinking via Reinforcement Learning (RL) typically suffers from the mode collapse of reasoning paths, where parallel thinking trajectories degenerate into similar ones. This homogeneity undermines the fundamental motivation of parallel thinking, that is, maintaining multiple hypotheses concurrently to prevent premature loss into a suboptimal solution. In this paper, we propose Diverse Parallel Thinking (DPT), a simple yet effective RL approach for parallel thinking designed to encourage path diversity. DPT rewards the model to develop distinct reasoning strategies by penalizing the prefix similarity of parallel thinking paths, thereby enhancing a more comprehensive exploration of the reasoning space. We conduct various experiments and analyses across multiple reasoning benchmarks to demonstrate the effectiveness of DPT. Results show that DPT successfully outperforms previous parallel thinking methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance over baselines. We validate path diversity as a key element to improve parallel thinking. Our code is available at https://github.com/JiaruQian/DPT.

summary.takeaway: 论文识别出强化学习式并行思维存在推理路径模式坍缩，并提出DPT通过惩罚并行路径前缀相似度来鼓励路径多样性。
summary.methods: 提出Diverse Parallel Thinking这一强化学习方法，对并行思维路径的前缀相似度施加惩罚以奖励不同推理策略，并在多个推理基准上进行实验与分析。
summary.relevance: 该工作与大语言模型、检索增强与对齐及强化学习相关，关注LLM推理中的探索多样性与训练信号设计。
summary.caveat: 摘要未披露具体基准、模型规模与奖励设计细节；路径多样性提升与最终答案正确性之间的权衡及其在不同模型上的可迁移性仍需进一步检验。

papers.title: RCSD: Reinforcement and Continual Learning for Domain-Specific Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by employing a compact draft model to propose candidate tokens that are verified in parallel by a target model. Conventional training relies on soft-label distillation, which forces the draft model to mimic the target's full output distribution, including high-entropy regions that degrade acceptance rates and increase early rejection risk. We propose RCSD (Reinforcement and Continual Learning for Speculative Decoding), a training framework that aligns draft model optimization with the system-level objective of maximizing acceptance length. RCSD leverages naturally occurring accepted and rejected sequences during speculative inference to construct implicit preference pairs, with masked loss to avoid penalizing target-aligned tokens. Evaluated across multiple benchmarks, RCSD improves average acceptance length by 35% over HASS and achieves 1.35x faster end-to-end inference than HASS on practical workloads, without compromising generation quality.

summary.takeaway: RCSD提出用推测解码中自然产生的接受与拒绝序列构造隐式偏好对，并以强化与持续学习训练草稿模型，使优化目标对齐接受长度。
summary.methods: 利用推测推理中的接受与拒绝序列构建隐式偏好对，采用掩码损失避免惩罚与目标模型一致的token，并在多个基准上与HASS比较接受长度和端到端推理速度。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于大语言模型推理加速与对齐，涉及持续学习式草稿模型训练，与检索增强与对齐及持续学习主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告相对HASS的平均接受长度与端到端加速，未说明具体模型规模、领域适配设置及长尾分布下的稳定性；生成质量"不受损"的结论需结合更全面评测确认。

papers.title: AtomicRL: Atomic Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown promise in robotic manipulation, but imitation learning (IL) alone often struggles to master complex long-horizon skills. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers an effective avenue for further improving VLA policies. However, existing VLA-RL methods typically suffer from delayed and biased credit assignment due to trajectory-level sparse rewards, while imbalanced subtask mastery creates bottlenecks that limit overall performance. To address these challenges, we propose AtomicRL, an RL post-training framework that leverages atomic task structures for reliable credit assignment and adaptive exploration. AtomicRL introduces Semantic-Aware Policy Optimization (SAPO), which uses semantic-aware gating to constrain TD residuals from failed atomic subtasks from propagating across task boundaries, mitigating credit contamination while preserving intra-subtask credit assignment and value bootstrapping. In addition, Bottleneck-Adaptive Target Exploration (BATE) dynamically coordinates task sampling and local exploration incentives based on the mastery of individual atomic subtasks, directing learning toward the remaining bottlenecks. Finally, we develop a Real2Sim2Real pipeline that bridges online RL in simulation with real-world deployment, facilitating practical transfer to physical robots. On LIBERO-LONG, AtomicRL achieves absolute performance gains of 3.6% and 4.0% over PPO across two VLA architectures. On CALVIN ABC-D, it improves full-task performance by up to 9.5% over PPO. Combined with the Real2Sim2Real pipeline, AtomicRL further improves real-world task performance by an average of 21.3%. These results demonstrate that AtomicRL effectively improves the learning efficiency and manipulation performance of VLA policies on long-horizon tasks.

summary.takeaway: AtomicRL提出基于原子任务结构的强化学习后训练框架，通过语义感知门控和瓶颈自适应探索改善长时程机器人操作的信用分配与探索。
summary.methods: 引入Semantic-Aware Policy Optimization，用语义感知门控限制失败原子子任务的TD残差跨任务边界传播；提出Bottleneck-Adaptive Target Exploration动态协调任务采样与局部探索；并构建Real2Sim2Real流程连接仿真在线RL与真机部署，在LIBERO-LONG和CALVIN ABC-D上评测。
summary.relevance: 该工作与强化学习及跨模态理解相关，面向视觉-语言-动作模型的长时程操作策略优化与真实迁移。
summary.caveat: 摘要中真机提升来自Real2Sim2Real管线组合，具体任务数量与硬件条件未说明；原子任务划分依赖先验结构，其在更开放任务中的可扩展性尚不明确。

papers.title: Memory-Centric Continual Learning for AI Agents
papers.abstract: Autonomous agents powered by foundation models can reason, plan, and use tools, but their fixed weights and context limits hinder sustained learning from experience over long-term deployment. While external memory systems attempt to bridge this gap, they mostly act as passive retrieval caches, evaluated primarily by whether they can recall stored facts or past interactions. Whether memory can drive genuine continual learning remains an open question. In this paper, we introduce Memory-Centric Continual Learning (MCCL), arguing that memory should be judged by whether it improves future actions, not merely what it retrieves. MCCL has three main parts. First, a three-axis taxonomy organizes memory by where state is stored (substrates), what form it takes (assets), and how it is managed (policies). This defines a two-loop lifecycle that updates memory state in an inner loop while refining management policies in an outer loop based on task feedback. Second, an evaluation protocol measures retention under interference, adaptation to change, and task transfer to isolate genuine behavioral gains from simple context expansion. Third, a memory scaling framework models how agent performance scales with experience, storage capacity, and compute budgets across non-parametric and parametric memory. Together, these components reframe agent memory from passive lookup to continuous learning, offering a principled route toward self-improving autonomous agents.

summary.takeaway: 论文提出以记忆为中心的持续学习MCCL，主张以记忆是否改善未来行动而非仅检索命中来评价智能体记忆，并给出分类、评测协议与扩展框架。
summary.methods: 提出三轴分类法按存储载体、记忆资产与管理策略组织记忆，定义内外双环生命周期；设计在干扰下保持、变化适应与任务迁移的评测协议，并建立记忆扩展框架刻画性能随经验、存储与计算预算的变化。
summary.relevance: 该工作与检索增强与对齐、持续学习及预训练主题相关，将外部记忆从被动检索缓存重新定位为持续学习机制。
summary.caveat: 摘要以框架与协议为主，未给出具体实验结果或数值；其分类与评测协议在真实长期部署中的有效性仍需实证检验。

papers.title: Temporal Evidence-Parameter Co-Alignment for LLM Reasoning over Temporal Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often struggle with temporally grounded reasoning because their static parametric memory is misaligned with the dynamic evolution of real-world knowledge. Although RAG and Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) provide practical ways to enhance LLMs, they remain insufficient for temporal reasoning. Existing retrieval methods typically prioritize semantic relevance while overlooking temporal validity, event order, and evolutionary dependencies, resulting in evidence that is relevant in isolation but temporally fragmented. Meanwhile, conventional PEFT methods usually employ fixed and input-agnostic low-rank updates, making it difficult to capture time-dependent entity semantics and relation drift. To address these limitations, we propose Temporal Evidence-Parameter Co-Alignment (TEPCA), a framework for LLM reasoning over TKGs. TEPCA aligns LLM reasoning with temporal knowledge at both the evidence and parameter levels. At the evidence level, it introduces time-constrained Dynamic Relevance-Guided Path (DRGP) pruning to preserve globally coherent temporal paths, together with Mutual-Information (MI)-based pruning to retain query-informative local facts under temporal constraints. At the parameter level, it integrates Dynamic-Gated LoRA (DG-LoRA), a timestamp-conditioned low-rank adaptation mechanism that dynamically modulates the effective adaptation subspace according to temporal context. This design enables LLMs to better capture fine-grained entity evolution and time-dependent relation semantics while preserving parameter efficiency. Experimental results on two TKG benchmarks demonstrate that TEPCA achieves state-of-the-art performance. Additional evaluations of DG-LoRA on eight commonsense QA datasets further verify its general input-adaptive capacity, scalability across LLM backbones, and interpretability.

summary.takeaway: 提出 TEPCA 框架，在证据与参数两个层面让 LLM 的时序知识图谱推理与时间知识对齐，并报告在两个 TKG 基准上取得最优性能。
summary.methods: 证据层面使用时间约束的动态相关性引导路径（DRGP）剪枝与基于互信息的剪枝；参数层面提出时间戳条件化的 Dynamic-Gated LoRA；在 2 个 TKG 基准上实验，并在 8 个常识 QA 数据集上评估 DG-LoRA。
summary.relevance: 直接面向大语言模型、检索增强与对齐及知识图谱主题，针对 LLM 静态参数记忆与时序知识动态演化不匹配的问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出相对结论（state-of-the-art、可扩展、可解释），未提供具体指标、消融幅度或基准名称。

papers.title: Towards Consistent Geospatial Representations: Aligning One Encoder to Many Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Geospatial foundation models (GFMs) differ widely in pretraining objective, modality and resolution, and none leads across benchmarks. We ask whether their representations are complementary, and whether a single encoder can inherit that complementarity. We introduce Pangaea-Latents, an extension of the Pangaea benchmark providing frozen embeddings of $5$ GFMs over its $11$ datasets, along with reproduced baselines, and find GFM embeddings to be neither redundant nor disjoint. We then propose GeoMixture, a preliminary framework to align a ViT to several GFMs per dataset through a multi-representation alignment (mREPA) objective. Our encoder ties the best GFM in average rank across nine Pangaea datasets, trading peak performance for cross-task consistency.

summary.takeaway: 发现多个地理空间基础模型的表示既不冗余也不完全重叠，并提出 GeoMixture 使单个 ViT 编码器通过多表示对齐继承这种互补性。
summary.methods: 扩展 Pangaea benchmark 为 Pangaea-Latents，提供 5 个 GFM 在 11 个数据集上的冻结嵌入与复现基线；提出以 mREPA 目标对齐 ViT 到多个 GFM 的 GeoMixture 框架。
summary.relevance: 涉及检索增强与对齐、预训练与自监督表示学习：核心问题是表示对齐与多模型互补性。
summary.caveat: GeoMixture 被描述为初步框架；结果主要是平均排名追平最佳 GFM，并以峰值性能换取跨任务一致性，摘要未给出具体数值。

papers.title: A Semantic Knowledge Graph Construction Pipeline for Vehicle Intention Prediction in nuScenes
papers.abstract: Knowledge graphs (KGs) are increasingly used in autonomous driving (AD) to make traffic scene entities and relations explicit for prediction and reasoning. Existing traffic-scene KGs, however, primarily emphasize trajectory forecasting or general scene understanding. This paper presents the nuScenes Intention Knowledge Graph (NIKG), a focused Web Ontology Language (OWL)-based semantic representation and construction pipeline for ego-centric vehicle intention context. NIKG instantiates nuScenes scenes as a self-describing Turtle graph and promotes three intention-relevant relations to first-class properties of each scene participant: ego-relative motion, spatial configuration, and time to collision (TTC) risk. The pipeline uses a small input contract available in many ego-centric driving datasets: ego pose, tracked object annotations, and temporal keyframe order. NIKG is released as an ontology-backed, self-describing graph artifact together with a reproducible construction pipeline and validation protocol for ego-centric intention context. Applying this pipeline to nuScenes mini yields a graph of 211,335 triples across 404 keyframes; under the validation protocol, ego-relative motion labels achieve 92.5% forward consistency. Coverage, semantic consistency, and temporal coherence analyses over this artifact are further reported. NIKG occupies the space between scene-oriented traffic KGs and intention-prediction models: a small, explicit semantic layer intended to support downstream work such as knowledge graph embedding (KGE), SPARQL-based feature extraction, or hybrid neuro-symbolic reasoning.

summary.takeaway: 发布 NIKG：一个基于 OWL 的语义知识图谱本体与构建管线，将 nuScenes 场景表示为以自车为中心的意图上下文图。
summary.methods: 以自车位姿、跟踪目标标注和关键帧时序为输入契约，把自车相对运动、空间构型和 TTC 风险提升为一等属性，输出 Turtle 图；在 nuScenes mini 上生成 211,335 个三元组、覆盖 404 个关键帧，并报告验证协议。
summary.relevance: 对应知识图谱与图谱构建与表示主题，为下游 KGE、SPARQL 特征提取和神经符号推理提供显式语义层。
summary.caveat: 仅在 nuScenes mini 上构建与验证；自车相对运动标签的前向一致性为 92.5%，其余为分析性报告，摘要未说明全量数据或下游预测增益。

papers.title: Spatially Informed and Direction Sensitive Representation Learning for Spatial Transcriptomics
papers.abstract: Cellular states are shaped by both intrinsic gene expression programs and the spatial microenvironment in which cells reside. Spatial transcriptomics makes this context measurable, but effective representation learning requires capturing both spatially informative molecular signals and intercellular organization. Existing approaches address these challenges only partially: conventional gene selection can overlook spatially structured signals, while methods for encoding cell-cell relationships often either reduce a cell's microenvironment to proximity alone, discarding direction, or rely on absolute coordinates tied to an arbitrary tissue frame. Consequently, cells with similar neighbor distances but distinct spatial organization may receive overly similar representations, despite experiencing different biological contexts that shape their cellular states. We introduce Tessera, a spatial representation learning framework that addresses both molecular selection and cellular context. Tessera combines spatially informed gene selection with a geometric inductive bias that contextualizes each cell within its local tissue environment. By modeling relative cell-cell relationships, Tessera is translation-invariant while preserving direction, allowing neighboring cells to contribute differently according to their spatial context and cellular state. Across held-out tissues and technologies, Tessera outperforms existing spatial foundation models in representation quality and generalizes zero-shot to contexts up to $16\times$ larger than those seen during training.

summary.takeaway: 提出 Tessera 空间表示学习框架，结合空间信息驱动的基因选择与保留方向性的几何归纳偏置，在留出组织与技术条件下优于现有空间基础模型。
summary.methods: 将每个细胞置于局部组织结构中建模相对细胞-细胞关系，实现平移不变同时保留方向；在多个留出组织和技术上评估表示质量，并测试零样本泛化到训练时最大 16 倍的空间语境。
summary.relevance: 对应预训练与自监督表示学习主题，面向空间转录组的表示学习与生物学上下文编码。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体基准名称、指标数值或与传统基因选择方法的消融对比；零样本泛化结论限于所述 16 倍规模。

papers.title: MAPS: Macro-Adaptive Parallel Reasoning for Regulating Search Momentum in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) by retrieving external knowledge. Recently, some RAG methods interleave reasoning and retrieval, enabling LLMs to progressively generate sub-queries and retrieve external knowledge. However, these methods may suffer from redundant or ineffective sub-queries and insufficiently diverse query exploration. Moreover, due to the tightly interleaved nature of reasoning and retrieval, it remains unclear how the evolving reasoning process influences query intent. To characterize the evolution of query intent during reasoning, we introduce search momentum, which captures the accumulated retrieval tendency induced by historical changes in generated sub-queries along the reasoning trajectory. Through momentum-based analysis, we find that the query generation process tends to continuously evolve along existing retrieval trajectories. Based on this observation, we propose MAPS, a Macro-Adaptive Parallel Reasoning framework for regulating search momentum and mitigating query-intent drift. MAPS first retains the retrieved knowledge and a refined reasoning state, thereby reducing the influence of historical reasoning trajectories on subsequent sub-query generation. Subsequently, MAPS extends the conventional sequential reasoning process into a parallel reasoning paradigm. At each iteration, MAPS identifies complementary retrieval directions, generates corresponding sub-queries for parallel retrieval, and consolidates the retrieved evidence to update the knowledge and reasoning states. Experiments on six question-answering benchmarks demonstrate that MAPS consistently outperforms representative RAG methods across different backbone models. All code and resources are available at https://github.com/NEUIR/MAPS.

summary.takeaway: 提出搜索动量概念以刻画推理过程中查询意图的演化，并提出 MAPS 通过宏观自适应并行推理调节搜索动量、缓解查询意图漂移。
summary.methods: 保留已检索知识与精炼推理状态以削弱历史轨迹影响，将顺序推理扩展为并行推理：每轮识别互补检索方向、并行生成子查询并整合证据；在 6 个问答基准、多种骨干模型上实验。
summary.relevance: 直接对应大语言模型与检索增强对齐主题，针对 RAG 中子查询冗余、探索不足及推理-检索紧耦合难以分析的问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告优于代表性 RAG 方法，未给出具体提升幅度、基准名称或动量分析的定量细节。

papers.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation Compositionality
papers.abstract: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds large language models in external knowledge. Modern pipelines combine embedding, chunking, retrieval, reranking, query augmentation, context compression, and agentic verification, yet these techniques are typically evaluated one at a time. It remains unclear whether their isolated gains survive composition, whether retrieval quality and answer faithfulness favor the same design choices, and whether conclusions from small corpora hold at large scale. We pre-declare three hypotheses and introduce LASAGNA, an open-source framework for controlled RAG evaluation. We test 450 configurations across eight benchmarks and corpora ranging from 5K to 200K documents. Three findings emerge. First, individually strong techniques from different phases of a RAG pipeline do not necessarily compose: three retrieval techniques predict a +47% combined improvement but deliver only +17% when used together. Second, component gains stack differently for retrieval and faithfulness, and optimizing one can hurt the other. Third, the best composition changes as the corpus grows: the combination that wins on a small corpus may not remain best at large scale. These findings show that gains measured in isolation are not reliable predictors of realistic performance, and that new RAG techniques should be tested with the full surrounding stack. We call on researchers to do so and supply LASAGNA to simplify these experiments.

summary.takeaway: 通过组合式评测发现 RAG 各组件的孤立增益不能可靠预测组合表现，检索质量与答案忠实度偏好不同设计，且最优组合随语料规模变化。
summary.methods: 预注册三个假设，提出开源受控评测框架 LASAGNA，在 8 个基准、5K 至 200K 文档语料上测试 450 种配置。
summary.relevance: 直接服务检索增强与对齐主题，检验嵌入、分块、检索、重排、查询增强、上下文压缩与智能体验证等环节组合后的真实效果。
summary.caveat: 摘要为概括性发现（如三种检索技术预测 +47% 而实际仅 +17%），未列出具体配置与基准明细；结论基于所测 450 种配置，外推需谨慎。

papers.title: One Act, Many Masks: Effect-Marginal Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract: Recent advances in multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) have substantially improved the performance of LLM agents on complex, long-horizon interactive tasks. However, despite progress in fine-grained credit assignment, policy optimization still applies these learning signals through response-specific probability ratios. Different textual responses can induce the same executable effect, yet credit differences arising from subsequent outcomes remain tied to their individual textual realizations. We identify this mismatch as credit-update misalignment. Our analysis reveals that credit-text pairing directly shapes policy-update directions, even when the policy context and executable effect are held fixed. Motivated by this finding, we propose Effect-Marginal Policy Optimization (EMPO), which aligns policy optimization with execution-level equivalence through an effect-level surrogate that couples updates across alternative textual realizations. EMPO preserves the original credit signals, integrates with both trajectory-level and step-level credit estimators, and requires no additional critics or rollouts. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Sokoban show that EMPO outperforms strong baselines in both task performance and learning efficiency.

papers.title: Auditing Confidence-Calibrated Benchmarking of Single-Cell Perturbation Models
papers.abstract: Single-cell perturbation models are increasingly assessed for both predictive performance and calibrated uncertainty under distribution shift. We constructed such an evaluation harness (two datasets, Norman 2019 and Replogle 2022; four split types over six dataset-split combinations; three models, scVI, CPA and a linear Ridge baseline; three uncertainty quantification methods, MC dropout, quantile regression and split conformal prediction) and then audited it against null baselines it had never included. Most of its headline results measure something other than what their metric names claim. The harness supplied each test cell to the model as input and then scored the model on reproducing that same cell's expression, so an identity predictor returning the input unchanged attains a perturbation-effect correlation of 1.0 on all six splits: any model given the target cell is measured against this echo ceiling rather than against a null. Against a constant train-mean predictor, scVI wins on 99.7% of Norman cells but only 0.2% of Replogle cells. One split held out sequencing batches rather than perturbations; another scores no genuinely novel perturbation after label collapse; unseen perturbations are silently replaced with a negative-control sentinel at inference; and the most convention-sensitive decision-value entry moves 29.2 percentage points under a library-size convention that changes that row's all-gene MSE by 0.01%. Because a validation budget is spent on a ranked shortlist rather than on a marginal interval, we also score each uncertainty signal by the DE-gene error it avoids in the top k: the worst-calibrated method is the best ranker, and a benchmark reporting only coverage orders the two backwards. We document six failure modes, each with its mechanism, the diagnostic that exposes it, and a detection procedure transferable to other harnesses. One result survives, with a boundary condition: split-conformal coverage calibrated on K562 residuals under-covers on RPE1 (0.900 to 0.847), and marginal coverage at the nominal 0.900 is compatible with covering 0.271 to 0.342 of the DE-gene intervals a prioritization decision would rest on. We continue to recommend conformal prediction, recalibrated per cellular context and reported per gene set rather than marginally.

summary.takeaway: 审计一个单细胞扰动模型的置信度校准评测框架，发现其多数头条指标测量的是与名称不符的东西，并记录六种失效模式及可迁移的检测流程。
summary.methods: 构建含 Norman 2019 与 Replogle 2022 两数据集、四种划分（六种数据集-划分组合）、scVI/CPA/Ridge 三模型及 MC dropout、分位数回归、split conformal 三种不确定性方法的评测框架，再引入此前缺失的零基线进行审计。
summary.relevance: 关联单细胞扰动主题与评测对齐：关注模型预测性能与不确定性校准在分布偏移下的评估是否可信。
summary.caveat: 结论高度依赖该特定框架与数据集；唯一保留的结果是 split conformal 在 K562 上校准后在 RPE1 上出现覆盖不足（0.900 到 0.847），并建议按细胞情境重新校准、按基因集报告。

papers.title: Melange: A Synthetic Visual Bias Benchmark for Multi-modal Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have seen broad adoption, but their biases are still far less examined than those of standard LLMs, creating possible social harms when deployed in real-world settings. Prior efforts to extend bias analyses from LLMs into the multi-modal space either cover only a few bias categories or do not ensure that the groups being compared are clearly addressed by visual cues in the images. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Melange, a wide-ranging synthetic visual benchmark covering seven categories for assessing social biases in MLLMs. It is grounded in the widely used language-only BBQ dataset (Bias Benchmark for Question Answering) from BigBench, carefully extending its constructed contexts via controlled generation of visual scenarios so the target attributes appear visually and clearly. To maximize reliability, our generated images pass through two stages of validation: automated screening using visual question answering (VQA) and subsequent manual inspection by human annotators. By systematically evaluating 23 open-source MLLMs across three matched evaluation settings---text-only, image-only, and image-with-context---Melange isolates the fairness effect of the input modality. Switching from text to vision reduces fairness by 0.291 on average, a gap that varies by model family rather than by scale alone. A perception control confirms that this gap is not an artifact of visual comprehension: models identify the depicted attributes at 90--95\% accuracy yet still fail to abstain. When models do commit to a biased answer, polarity-aware stereotype alignment shows they choose the human-stereotypical response roughly three-quarters of the time.

summary.takeaway: 提出 Melange，一个覆盖七类社会偏见的多模态合成视觉基准，用于系统评估 MLLM 的视觉偏见，并发现从文本切换到视觉会平均降低公平性。
summary.methods: 基于语言基准 BBQ 的构造上下文，通过受控生成视觉场景构建图像，并经过 VQA 自动筛查与人工检查两阶段验证；在文本、图像、图像加上下文三种匹配设置下评估 23 个开源 MLLM。
summary.relevance: 直接关系到大语言模型的对齐与公平性问题，并将偏见分析扩展到多模态大模型，补充了检索增强与对齐主题下对模型偏见的评测需求。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告了公平性下降幅度和刻板印象对齐比例，但这些结论来自其合成基准和特定模型集合，向真实部署场景的外推需谨慎；视觉属性高识别率与不弃答之间的机制未在摘要中展开。

papers.title: CrashGym: Measuring the Decision Value of Experimentation for LLM Agents in Counterfactual Market Crashes
papers.abstract: Language-model agents are increasingly asked to run experiments, yet benchmarks rarely measure whether those experiments improve the decisions they are meant to inform. We introduce CrashGym, a deterministic, replayable limit-order-book simulator in which an agent must choose between a deleveraging intervention and a liquidity backstop for a market about to suffer a shock-triggered crash. Before committing, the agent may query intervention experiments in a laboratory realization of the market. Its choice is then scored on an independently seeded target realization in which the simulator executes every feasible intervention, so regret relative to the best intervention is computed by directly simulating every alternative on the same target repeats, with no human or model-based judging. The simulator implements each amplification channel---persistent price impact, liquidity withdrawal, margin-driven liquidation, and an evolving strategy mix---as an explicit mechanism that can be switched on in stages. In a prospectively specified study on 24 newly sampled worlds, laboratory access reduces the mean regret of the one deployment with a complete record (Luna) from 8.878 to 3.785, a paired reduction of 5.092 utility units (nominal 95% world-bootstrap interval: 1.028--9.507), or 57.4% of the OBSERVE-ONLY mean. Prospective comparisons for two further deployments are incomplete; in a separate exploratory study, mean regret is lower with laboratory access for all four deployments evaluated. A laboratory whose strategy mix evolves endogenously yields no established advantage over one with a fixed mix. CrashGym thus measures the value of experimentation as avoided decision loss and lets simulator detail be judged by the decisions it supports.

summary.takeaway: 提出 CrashGym，一个确定性可重放的限价订单簿模拟器，用于衡量 LLM agent 在反事实市场崩盘决策中通过实验获得的信息价值。
summary.methods: 构建可切换市场放大机制的模拟环境，agent 可在实验室实现中查询干预实验，再在独立目标实现上评分 regret；在 24 个新采样世界中进行预设研究，并比较实验室策略混合固定与内生的差异。
summary.relevance: 涉及大语言模型作为决策 agent 的评测与对齐，强调实验对决策质量的贡献，与检索增强和对齐中关于 agent 可靠性的讨论相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要显示仅一个部署具有完整记录，另两个部署的前瞻比较不完整；实验室策略内生演化的优势未获确立；结果基于该模拟器的特定市场机制设定。

papers.title: RAG-NIMBF: A Non-Invasive, Modular Benchmarking Framework for Automated RAG Configuration Analysis
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become the dominant paradigm for grounding the outputs of large language models (LLM) in external knowledge. However, practitioners are faced with a vast configuration space comprising chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, prompting and generation models, and there is limited guidance on how these components interact. We present RAG-NIMBF, a modular benchmarking framework that attaches to existing RAG pipelines as a non-invasive evaluation layer. It evaluates the configuration space through controlled ablation with end-to-end experiment tracking. The evaluation combines LLM-based answer quality scores, retrieval correctness measures, and runtime indicators. This study validates the framework across multiple generation models on the SQuAD dataset. This process reveals non-obvious interactions and demonstrates how the experiments are tracked. The findings indicate that the retrieval balance of relevance and diversity substantially enhances the relevance and coverage of retrieved context in comparison to a conventional similarity search, with MMR raising nDCG@5 by +4 to +11 percentage points across the swept models. More detailed prompt instructions meaningfully increase how faithfully generated answers stick to the retrieved evidence, especially for capable and reasoning models (+10 to +13pp on Qwen3.6-27B, GPT-4o-mini and Qwen3.5-think, but negligible on the 20B generator). Overall, RAG-NIMBF transforms the configuration space of RAG into reproducible, comparable experiments. By attaching to existing production pipelines in a non-invasive way, it enables practitioners to systematically evaluate and improve deployed systems without disrupting existing workflows. This replaces ad hoc choices with evidence-based decisions.

summary.takeaway: 提出 RAG-NIMBF，一个非侵入式模块化基准框架，用于自动分析 RAG 配置空间中组件交互并进行可复现的消融实验。
summary.methods: 作为附加评估层接入现有 RAG 流水线，结合 LLM 答案质量评分、检索正确性指标与运行时指标，在 SQuAD 上跨多个生成模型验证，并追踪端到端实验。
summary.relevance: 直接对应检索增强与对齐主题，针对 RAG 配置选择缺乏指导的问题提供系统评测方法。
summary.caveat: 验证主要基于 SQuAD 数据集和有限生成模型集合，摘要所报告的 MMR 与提示细节带来的提升幅度是否适用于其他领域和更大规模生产系统尚不明确。

papers.title: RL-IF: Tracking Non-local Training Data Influence for Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Online reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved significant success in decision-making tasks, but modern online RL remains highly sensitive to the quality of training experience. Understanding the contribution of individual training instances is therefore central to data-centric RL, with applications ranging from experience selection to policy interpretation. Existing data attribution methods for online RL primarily focus on local influence within a single training round, overlooking the non-local data influence across multiple training rounds. In this work, we formalize data attribution in online RL through a trajectory-level leave-one-out quantity, RL-LOO, which measures how one training sample influences a downstream target after subsequent online updates have taken place. We then derive RL-IF, a first-order estimator that propagates data influence through both optimization effects and policy-induced sampling effects, and provide theoretical guarantees on its approximation accuracy under smoothness assumptions. Our analysis further disentangles these two effects and shows both theoretically and empirically that the full RL-IF estimator can often be well approximated using the optimization effect alone. Building on this observation, we develop RINSE, a practical data filtering method for online RL. Experiments on standard control benchmarks and an RLHF-style toxicity-mitigation setting show that RINSE improves training efficiency and final performance over standard PPO and local attribution baselines. These results suggest that RL-IF provides a practical and principled framework for understanding and improving online RL.

summary.takeaway: 将在线 RL 的数据归因形式化为轨迹级 leave-one-out 量 RL-LOO，并推导一阶估计器 RL-IF，进而提出数据过滤方法 RINSE。
summary.methods: RL-IF 同时传播优化效应和策略诱导采样效应，并在平滑性假设下给出近似保证；基于仅优化效应可良好近似的观察构建 RINSE，在控制基准和 RLHF 风格毒性缓解设置中与 PPO 及局部归因基线比较。
summary.relevance: 与强化学习和多智能体与奖励学习主题相关，为在线 RL 和 RLHF 中的数据选择与策略解释提供归因框架。
summary.caveat: 理论保证依赖平滑性假设；摘要未说明在更复杂或高维任务上的扩展性，也未量化归因估计的额外计算开销。

papers.title: Training-Free Continual Learning for Multimodal Forecasting via Prompt Evolution
papers.abstract: Adapting a forecasting system to a changing world classically means retraining. We ask whether the task of continually learning regimes for time series forecasting can be represented by a piece of text: a guidance block, evolved by outcome-driven reflection and used in a frozen LLM forecaster's prompt. On a refreshed multimodal benchmark (weekly search indices, daily currencies, daily commodities, each window paired with web-retrieved news), we run GEPA-style prompt evolution under strict contamination control to prevent the data leakage common in timeseries benchmarks: the forecaster's knowledge cutoff predates every evaluated window. A 900-word evolved guidance carried by Llama-3.3-70B beats TimeSeries Foundation Models (TSFMs) on held-out data (GM MASE 0.776 vs. 0.898 for TabPFN-TS-3), transfers to more recent models without measurable loss, and costs dollars rather than GPU-days to update. We characterize the loop: out-of-loop gains concentrate in the first reflection, in-loop improvements overstate out-of-loop gains 2-3x unless an untouched monitor arbitrates, and error-only objectives silently suppress the text modality. We provide two extensions. First, compiling the guidance into executable code with a TSFM as a callable tool recovers most of the gain deterministically. Second, ablations show the advantage widens at short horizons and that removing the news text does not hurt the guided forecaster, consistent with the text's value being distilled into policy during learning. We argue that continual prompt evolution is a practical, training-free alternative to retraining for multimodal forecasting.

summary.takeaway: 提出用提示演化替代重训练的免训练持续学习方案，让冻结 LLM 通过一段演化出的文本指导块适应时间序列预测中的新 regime。
summary.methods: 在刷新后的多模态基准（每周搜索指数、每日汇率、每日商品，并配对网络检索新闻）上，在严格防污染控制下运行 GEPA 风格提示演化；将指导编译为可执行代码并做消融分析。
summary.relevance: 对应持续学习与预训练主题，探索冻结预训练模型在分布变化下的持续适应，并涉及多模态新闻文本的使用。
summary.caveat: 结果主要来自单一演化指导块和特定基准；摘要指出环内改进会高估环外收益，且仅用误差目标会抑制文本模态；新闻文本移除后不损害引导预测器，说明文本价值机制尚未完全厘清。

papers.title: BitMTP: When Multi-Token Prediction Meets Low-Bit Large Language Models
papers.abstract: For efficient deployment of large language models (LLMs), methods of ultra-low-bit backbones reduce weight storage, memory traffic, and linear-layer execution cost, while multi-token prediction (MTP) methods reduce sequential decoding steps by predicting multiple future tokens in parallel. Although complementary, the direct combination of these methods cannot accelerate decoding at comparable quality: masked drafting lacks intermediate token input supplied in next-token training, while wider computation and causal key-value (KV) updates can offset the savings from fewer steps. To address these challenges, we propose BitMTP, an algorithm-system co-design framework for efficient MTP on ultra-low-bit LLM backbones. A joint next-token prediction and MTP objective equips a single model with both autoregressive (AR) generation and block-causal drafting. Confidence-only decoding, speculative-only decoding, and hybrid decoding provide different quality-throughput operating points without using separate draft and verifier models. Accepted-prefix alignment keeps the committed prefix, materialized causal KV boundary, and CUDA Graph replay state consistent for continued generation. BitMTP uses this contract to select width-specialized low-bit execution and reuse captured graphs over shared KV storage. On NVIDIA H20, BitMTP with hybrid decoding achieves five-task mean speedups of 2.2x on BitNet b1.58-2B and 2.1-2.4x on 1.7B-4B Bonsai models at comparable task quality. On RTX 3090 and Jetson Orin, it further achieves up to 2.0x in five-task mean throughput and 3.3x on MBPP+, respectively. These results demonstrate that BitMTP accelerates ultra-low-bit LLM generation across backbones, model sizes, and GPU types. The source code is released at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/BitMTP

summary.takeaway: 提出 BitMTP，一种算法-系统协同设计框架，将多 token 预测与超低比特 LLM 主干结合，在可比质量下加速解码。
summary.methods: 联合下一 token 预测与 MTP 目标训练单一模型，支持置信度解码、推测解码和混合解码；通过接受前缀对齐保持提交前缀、因果 KV 边界与 CUDA Graph 重放状态一致，并选择宽度专用的低比特执行。
summary.relevance: 面向大语言模型的高效推理与部署，属于大语言模型主题下的推理加速工作，与对齐后的模型服务效率相关。
summary.caveat: 加速数据来自 H20、RTX 3090 和 Jetson Orin 上的特定模型规模与任务集合；摘要未报告低比特量化对更广泛任务质量或安全对齐属性的影响。

papers.title: From Generic to Dedicated: A Novel Optimizer for Online Continual Learning
papers.abstract: Online Continual Learning (OCL) requires models to learn from non-stationary data streams under a strict single-pass constraint, making them highly susceptible to catastrophic forgetting. While existing studies have explored various strategies from data, architecture, and optimization perspectives, the optimizer often directly uses generic approaches such as SGD and AdamW. In this work, we reveal a new link between optimization dynamics and OCL needs by recasting Polyak-Ruppert averaging as the engine of "plasticity" and Primal averaging as the anchor of "stability". This inspires our novel optimizer, SPIN (Stability-Plasticity INterpolation), which explicitly decouples plasticity and stability by interpolating between a fast-moving "plasticity" sequence and an adaptive "stability" sequence. We theoretically demonstrate that SPIN implicitly employs an inverse Hessian approximation, providing crucial Tikhonov regularization to damp noisy, single-sample Hessian estimates and mitigate forgetting. More importantly, SPIN can be seamlessly integrated into existing OCL methods by taking resulted gradients as input and replacing standard optimizers. Extensive experiments show that using SPIN instead of standard optimizers yields consistent and significant performance gains across multiple OCL approaches, including the challenging rehearsal-free setting and under strict memory constraints.

summary.takeaway: 提出新的在线持续学习优化器 SPIN，通过插值快速移动的塑性序列与自适应稳定性序列显式解耦塑性与稳定性。
summary.methods: 将 Polyak-Ruppert 平均视为塑性引擎、Primal 平均视为稳定性锚点，理论上说明 SPIN 隐含逆 Hessian 近似并提供 Tikhonov 正则；以现有 OCL 方法产生的梯度为输入替换标准优化器，在多种 OCL 设置中实验。
summary.relevance: 直接对应持续学习主题，并提供可与检索增强与对齐流程中在线适应方法结合的通用优化组件。
summary.caveat: 摘要主要报告一致性能增益，未给出具体基准范围或超参数敏感性；理论分析依赖的近似条件与在非凸深度网络中的实际行为需进一步验证。

papers.title: Foundation-Style Pretraining for Scalable and Transferable Distributed PV Forecasting
papers.abstract: The rapid growth of distributed photovoltaic (PV) generation is increasing the demand for accurate forecasting across large numbers of geographically dispersed stations. Existing approaches are commonly developed for individual sites or specific forecasting horizons, requiring repeated training and maintenance as new stations are integrated and limiting direct reuse at previously unseen sites. To address this scalability gap, this paper presents a domain-specific foundation-style pretraining framework that learns a shared forecasting model from heterogeneous multi-site and multi-horizon PV data. NWP-assisted forecasting is formulated as a sequence-completion problem that unifies historical PV power, meteorological observations, future numerical weather prediction (NWP) forecasts, and time encodings. Three pretraining objectives are designed and systematically evaluated, including forecast-aligned reconstruction, generic reconstruction, and mixed reconstruction. The mixed objective combines the operational structure of PV forecasting with random sequence reconstruction and provides the most balanced performance across forecasting accuracy, degraded NWP conditions, and downstream adaptation. Experiments on 479 distributed PV stations use 340 stations for model development and 139 spatially held-out stations for zero-shot evaluation.
